_meta.description: 环境介质与物理互动词库：打破 AI 生成的人物'抠图感'和'绿幕感'
_meta.usage: Seedance/MJ 提示词中环境介质与人物物理交互的权威参考

media_types.name: 风
media_types.wrongExample: 狂风中，角色的头发一丝不乱，衣服像铁板一样
media_types.correctInteraction: 风不仅要吹动，还要改变人物的姿态
prompts: hair whipping across the face, clothes billowing violently in the wind, leaning forward against the gale, squinting eyes
fabric caught in strong gusts, robes streaming behind, dust and leaves swirling in the air
character bracing against the wind, one hand shielding face, clothes snapping and rippling
visualCheck: 衣服的褶皱必须有拉扯感
必须有飞舞的碎叶或沙尘

media_types.name: 雨
media_types.wrongExample: 背景在下雨，人物身上干爽，没有水渍
media_types.correctInteraction: 雨水必须附着在材质上，并影响光线反射
prompts: heavy downpour, wet hair plastered to the forehead, rain droplets splashing off armor/shoulders, soaked clothes clinging to the skin, reflections on wet pavement
rain-soaked fabric with visible water stains, droplets running down the face, puddles reflecting surroundings
torrential rain, character's hair and clothes completely drenched, water streaming off the body, visible breath condensation
visualCheck: 皮肤和皮革上必须有高光反射（湿润感）
雨滴砸在肩膀上必须碎裂

media_types.name: 雾/烟/尘
media_types.wrongExample: 清晰通透的废墟，背景一览无余
media_types.correctInteraction: 用烟尘遮挡远景，降低对比度，增加纵深感
prompts: thick morning mist obscuring the background, floating dust particles illuminated by light, lingering gun smoke, hazy atmosphere
volumetric fog with visible dust motes, depth fading into white/gray, atmospheric haze reducing contrast in the distance
smoke drifting across the scene, particles catching the light, air perspective making distant objects fade
visualCheck: 距离镜头越远的物体，对比度越低、颜色越灰（空气透视）

media_types.name: 雪/寒冷
media_types.wrongExample: 背景有雪，人物毫无寒冷特征
media_types.correctInteraction: 寒冷是生理反应，必须体现在微表情和附着物上
prompts: visible freezing breath, unmelted snowflakes resting on eyelashes and shoulders, red nose and flushed cheeks, huddled posture
frost on eyelashes, cold-reddened cheeks and nose, visible breath condensation, snow accumulating on hair and shoulders
character shivering slightly, hunched posture against cold, snow dusting their dark hair, fingers slightly blue-tinted

interaction_quality_test.description: 绿幕测试：如果把背景换成纯黑，人物的状态是否依然成立
failConditions: 人物状态与背景毫无互动
光线方向与场景光源不一致
passConditions: 人物身上有介质反应（湿润、附着物、风吹姿态）
光线与环境匹配（潮湿地面反光、雾气散射）
微表情符合环境（眯眼、缩颈、颤抖）
